submitted.rationale: With only 3 merit measurements, I sampled along the Fe axis. The photocurrent went up steadily with Fe content: 8 (V-rich) gave 2e-8 A, 160 (Fe:V near 1:1, FeVO4-like) gave 1.2e-7 A, and 145 (the most Fe-rich candidate in the library, lowest V) gave 4.8e-7 A. This fits Fe-oxide-rich absorbers being the most active under 2.72 eV light.
